LESSON: READING 8.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING: NARRATIVES

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.2: Reading 8.2.1 Extensive Reading: Narratives
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 8.2.1 Extensive Reading: Narratives, part of Strand 8 in Grade 5 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: What should you consider when reading silently? 2. How do you keep a record of learnt vocabulary?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. team up with peers to collect a variety of narratives from the community,

2. read level readers and identify the characters in the stories,

3. make a summary of events in the narratives,

4. find meaning of vocabulary used from context,

5. use a dictionary to confirm meaning of vocabulary from texts,

6. make a list of synonyms and opposites of words from the vocabulary identified,

7. discuss lessons learnt from level readers,

8. visit a library to select a grade appropriate material for individual reading. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. team up with peers to collect a variety of narratives from the community,
2. read level readers and identify the characters in the stories,
3. make a summary of events in the narratives,
4. find meaning of vocabulary used from context,
5. use a dictionary to confirm meaning of vocabulary from texts,
6. make a list of synonyms and opposites of words from the vocabulary identified,
7. discuss lessons learnt from level readers,
8. visit a library to select a grade appropriate material for individual reading. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 8.2.1 Extensive Reading: Narratives together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn: This is enhanced as the learner builds on their learning experiences by searching for meaning of

vocabulary from contexts and in the dictionary.

• Critical thinking and Problem solving: This is cultivated as the learner analyses concepts to make a list of synonyms and

opposites of words from the vocabulary identified.

Values:
• Responsibility: This is nurtured as the learner exhibits a self-driven attitude when visiting a library to select a grade

appropriate material for individual reading.

• Unity: This is promoted as the learner teams up with peers to collect a variety of narratives from the community.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

ICT: This is promoted as the learner reads and interacts with content on care for digital devices.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the concept on vocabulary from the theme on care for digital devices to their learning of technology in
